WITH eligible_stays AS (
  -- female patients aged 82-92 (inclusive), get their hospital admissions (hadm_id)
  SELECT DISTINCT a.hadm_id
  FROM `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` a
  JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
    ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id
  WHERE LOWER(p.gender) = 'f'
    AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 82 AND 92
    AND a.hadm_id IS NOT NULL
),
map_itemids AS (
  -- identify itemids corresponding to MAP / mean arterial pressure
  SELECT itemid
  FROM `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.d_items`
  WHERE (
    LOWER(IFNULL(label, '')) LIKE '%mean arterial%' 
    OR LOWER(IFNULL(label, '')) LIKE '%mean arterial pressure%' 
    OR LOWER(IFNULL(label, '')) LIKE '%map%' 
    OR LOWER(IFNULL(abbreviation, '')) LIKE '%map%'
  )
),
max_map_per_stay AS (
  -- for each eligible hadm_id, compute the maximum MAP recorded in ICU chartevents
  SELECT
    ce.hadm_id,
    MAX(ce.valuenum) AS max_map
  FROM `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.chartevents` ce
  JOIN map_itemids mi
    ON ce.itemid = mi.itemid
  JOIN eligible_stays es
    ON ce.hadm_id = es.hadm_id
  WHERE ce.valuenum IS NOT NULL
    AND ce.hadm_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ce.hadm_id
),
ordered_agg AS (
  -- aggregate ordered max_map values into an array to compute exact median
  SELECT
    ARRAY_AGG(max_map ORDER BY max_map) AS arr,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM max_map_per_stay
)
SELECT
  -- compute median: handle odd/even counts
  CASE
    WHEN cnt = 0 THEN NULL
    WHEN MOD(cnt, 2) = 1 THEN
      -- odd: pick the middle element
      arr[OFFSET(CAST(FLOOR((cnt - 1) / 2.0) AS INT64))]
    ELSE
      -- even: average the two middle elements
      (
        arr[OFFSET(CAST(FLOOR((cnt / 2.0) - 1) AS INT64))] +
        arr[OFFSET(CAST(FLOOR(cnt / 2.0) AS INT64))]
      ) / 2.0
  END AS median_of_max_map_per_stay,
  cnt AS number_of_stays_with_map
FROM ordered_agg;

      arr[OFFSET(CAST(FLOOR((cnt - 1) / 2.0) AS INT64))]

      -- even: average the two middle elements
      (
        arr[OFFSET(CAST(FLOOR((cnt / 2.0) - 1) AS INT64))] +
        arr[OFFSET(CAST(FLOOR(cnt / 2.0) AS INT64))]
      ) / 2.0
  END AS median_of_max_map_per_stay,
  cnt AS number_of_stays_with_map
FROM ordered_agg;
